input_text: All people who eat salads regularly are very conscious about their health and eating habits. All people who grew up in health-conscious childhood homes eat salads regularly. All people who fulfill their daily nutritional intakes grew up in health-conscious childhood homes. All people who disregard their physical well-being are not very conscious about their health and eating habits. If people visit the gym at least once a day, then they always fulfill their daily nutritional intakes. Taylor either grew up in a health-conscious childhood home and disregard her physical well-being, or she did neither. Taylor visits the gym at least once a day?
answer:
Let me work through this.

Taylor visits the gym at least once a day → fulfills daily nutritional intakes → grew up in health-conscious childhood home → eats salads regularly → very conscious about health and eating habits.

Also: very conscious about health and eating habits → NOT disregards physical well-being (contrapositive of "disregards → not very conscious").

The condition about Taylor: either (grew up in health-conscious home AND disregards physical well-being) OR (did NOT grow up in health-conscious home AND does NOT disregard physical well-being).

If Taylor visits the gym at least once a day, then she grew up in a health-conscious home AND is very conscious (not disregarding). So the first option (grew up AND disregards) is false. The second option requires NOT grew up in health-conscious home, but we established she did grow up in one — contradiction.

So Taylor cannot visit the gym at least once a day.

False.
